title: Classic Horror Music Bingo on Friday 16 October
preheader: £5 cash entry, two themed rounds and a 7pm start. Reserve online, pay on the night.

data.heading: Two rounds of horror soundtracks
body: Nikki hosts two fully themed rounds of Music Bingo, built from classic horror soundtracks, spooky favourites and monster hits. Listen to each clip, match it to the titles on your card and mark the square. No expert music knowledge needed.
Reserve online, pay on the night. Entry costs £5 per person, payable in cash when you arrive. No online payment is taken.

image.alt: Screams and Soundtracks classic horror Music Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

rows.label: Dressing up
rows.value: Encouraged, and a small themed touch counts

rows.label: Seating
rows.value: Communal tables, book your group together

data.heading: A few things to know
body: The theme is theatrical and playful rather than genuinely frightening, so bring whoever you like. Expect prizes, quick games and plenty of crowd participation.
Come early for dinner, served from 4pm to 9pm, and settle in before the first round.

data.body: Book everyone in your group together, then decide what you are wearing.
data.script_line: Scream if you get a line

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
